lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着藤蔓走。
lines.en: I keep low and move through the vines.

lines.zh: 我在林下走，脚步几乎没有声音。
lines.en: I walk the understory almost silently.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，找水豚的脚印。
lines.en: I follow the riverbank, hunting capybara tracks.
I walk, shoulders rolling.

lines.zh: 我绕过一棵大树，没有碰到藤。
lines.en: I go around a big tree without touching a vine.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴垂着，只有末端在动。
lines.en: My tail hangs, only the tip moving.

lines.zh: 我踩过落叶，叶子只轻轻一响。
lines.en: I cross the leaf litter; it whispers once.

lines.zh: 我朝声音的方向慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the sound.
I stop and lift my head to test the wind.
I slip between the ferns.
I retreat into the tree shade.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地绕过一丛灌木。
lines.en: I work slowly around a thicket.
I creep forward a good distance.
I approach the river flat step by step.
I stop behind a root.
I take two more steps.
I reach the forest edge and crouch.
My ears turn toward the sound.

lines.zh: 我盯着河边的那片空地。
lines.en: I stare at the open ground by the river.

lines.zh: 风里有水豚的味，我抬起头。
lines.en: Capybara scent on the wind; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛贴地，尾巴不动。
lines.en: My shoulders hug the ground; my tail is still.
I close my eyes once and open them.

lines.zh: 我身上的斑纹在光影里散开。
lines.en: My spots break up in the dappled light.
I lie there and wait.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪后腿，调整姿势。
lines.en: I shift my hind legs to adjust.
I hear capybara footsteps.
I rest my chin on my paws.

lines.zh: 我很安静，比这片林子还安静。
lines.en: I am quiet. Quieter than the forest.

lines.zh: 我又朝另一个方向看了看。
lines.en: I look another way.

lines.zh: 我没有动，只是眼睛跟着。
lines.en: I do not move. Only my eyes follow.

lines.zh: 我在树影里看你，没有动。
lines.en: I watch you from the shade without moving.
You walk too loudly.
I lift my head from my paws.
I turn my ears forward.

lines.zh: 你身上没有水豚的味道。
lines.en: You do not smell of capybara.
I settle low again.
You step back; I do not rise.
I ease out from behind the tree a little.

lines.zh: 你所在的树影我记住了。
lines.en: I have noted the shade you stand in.
I retreat into the shade again.
I spring back and flatten.
My shoulder twitches.
Something rolls in my throat.
I lick the wound twice.
My tail tucks.
I slip two steps further back.
I press my belly to the ground.
I drag a hind leg back into the ferns.

lines.zh: 血从耳根滴下，我不眨眼。
lines.en: Blood drips from my ear; I don't blink.
I lift my head and look closely.
I am not quite sure yet.
I push my body up, inch by inch.
I take one step and stop.

lines.zh: 我凑过去闻了闻，还不确定。
lines.en: I lean in and sniff; I am not sure yet.
I bite and drag it back.
I eat quickly.
I withdraw into the shade again.
I hide what is left.
I settle low beside you.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你拿东西的手。
lines.en: I keep watching the hand that holds it.
I creep forward another little stretch.
You hit me; I spring away at once.
I retreat behind a tree and flatten.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你腿上划了一道。
lines.en: My claws leave a line on your leg.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我比看着更重。
lines.en: We collide. I am heavier than I look.
I twist aside and land clear.
I shake my head without a sound.
I circle you, keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 你撞来，我贴着落叶滑开。
lines.en: You charge; I slide low over the leaves.
I slip back two more steps.
There is no anger in me.
Another comes from across the river.

lines.zh: 它的胡须扫过我的脸，很轻。
lines.en: Its whiskers brush my face, lightly.
I rest my chin on its neck.
It licks the base of my ear.
We lie in the shade together.
Its spots are denser than mine.
We watch the river flat together.
It rises first; I follow.
We walk side by side at the water.

lines.zh: 它往林子里去了，我没有跟。
lines.en: It goes into the trees. I do not follow.
I take it and pin it underfoot.
I sniff once and put it down.
I sniff it and flick it aside with a paw.
I drag it behind a tree.
I bite once to test it.
I bat it back to your feet.
I toss it aside.
I examine it for a while.
I release it and walk off.
I flatten, ready to move.
My shoulders bunch.
I set off toward you.

lines.zh: 我的落脚几乎没有声响。
lines.en: My footfalls make almost no sound.
I have chosen to come from the side.
There are few steps left between us.

lines.zh: 我的爪垫踩过腐叶，没声。
lines.en: My pads cross rotting leaves without a sound.
I hear the footsteps of a capybara.
I follow behind, low to the ground.

lines.zh: 你转身，我已经换到另一边。
lines.en: You turn; I am already on the other side.
I track you around the trees.
You cut me; I back off and return.
I do not call out. Never a sound.
I wait for you to expose your back.
I close in inch by inch.
Your steps are starting to break.
I am one spring away.

lines.zh: 我从侧面扑，牙找你的后颈。
lines.en: I lunge from the side, teeth seeking your nape.
I bite your shoulder.
I bring you down from behind.
I rake your back and press down.
I shake my head and drag you.
I drive my shoulder into your knees.
You throw me off; I land turning.
In the jungle I watch the capybara.

lines.zh: 斑纹贴着你的背，我不松口。
lines.en: My spots press your back; I don't let go.
I step out of the vines.
I crouch first and look around.

lines.zh: 这里有很多水豚的痕迹。
lines.en: There are many capybara tracks here.
I head for the river.

lines.zh: 我的斑纹在树影里散开。
lines.en: My spots break up in the shade.
I walk slowly to the forest edge.
I lower my head and sniff the ground.

lines.zh: 我找到一处可以伏的地方。
lines.en: I find a place to lie low.
I start along the bank.

lines.zh: 我记住了这片林子的路。
lines.en: I learn the paths of this forest.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的毛，我滚了一圈。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur; I roll once.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，落在落叶里。
lines.en: I fall from a tree into the leaves.

lines.zh: 水比我以为的深，我蹬不上来。
lines.en: The water is deeper than I thought; I cannot climb out.
That light makes my pupils shrink.
Too hungry to stir from where I lie.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整只跳起来。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I leap up whole.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以落脚的枝。
lines.en: There is no branch to land on here.
